_comment: Cells whose verifier is demonstrably broken. Kept in the task set (the history must stay comparable) but excluded from scores by `bench_report.py report|compare` unless --include-task-side is passed. Evidence lives in docs/moca-bench-report.md and docs/agents-bench-report.md; add a row here only after reading the verifier AND the transcripts.

configure-git-webserver.why: verifier asserts only that 'TEST PASSED' appears in stdout; the clone/push checks are not asserted and expect timeouts are ignored, so a leftover /var/www/html/hello.html passes with no sshd installed
configure-git-webserver.evidence: docs/agents-bench-report.md#task-side-cells (PR #6): claude passed in run 2 with no sshd, pi needed a chpasswd trick, moca built the whole stack correctly and failed the 404

filter-js-from-html.why: byte-exact expectation plus verifier timeouts: 0 passes in 25 attempts across the 12-task hold study, two attempts died as VerifierTimeoutError

build-cython-ext.why: verifier clones pyknotid 0.5.3 from GitHub at verification time and asserts ITS upstream test suite passes (pip-installing pytest into the container); one upstream test (…reconstructed_space_curve) now fails, so the reference solution cannot pass — oracle 0/3 while all four agents passed the same cell 8/8 on 2026-10-25/26
